messages:
alex: Heads up — I sketched a compact telemetry view for prefetch/prompt caching savings that slices by model, route, and tenant. Wanted quick feedback before I wire it into dashboards.

mira: Nice. Can you share the mock? especially interested in token-saved math and how we attribute to "warmup" vs prefix hits.

alex: pasted mock here: https://internal.redwood/sheets/prefetch-telemetry-v1 (private). Key panels: per-model token-saved/day, route-level hit-rate trend, tenant top-10 savings, and a small panel showing 'reason breakdown' (warmup | prefix | kv-lookup miss).

sam: Love the reason breakdown. A question: where are we pulling "warmup" attribution from? current signal has ambiguity when a request benefits from both cached KV and prefix.

acheng: We heuristically attribute to the earliest cached segment used. If a prefix cache returns a full prefix match we count it as prefix; if prefix miss but KV had values we mark warmup. It's lossy but reproducible.

mira: Can we add a confidence column? like "pure prefix" vs "mixed" with a flag so ops can filter.

alex: Good call — will add a binary "mixed_hit" flag to the event payload. That lets dashboards show conservative vs optimistic token-saved.

sam: Also we should surface kernel selection / batching impact. Last perf run showed per-token latency variance when kernel fallback occurs, which could change cost assumptions. Maybe a tiny panel: percent of requests that used slower kernel path by model.

acheng: Agree. I can emit a small metric: kernel_path = {fast, fallback, quantized_fallback}. Will tag it on the same events for correlation.

ops-bot: deploy-bot posted a new metric export: telemetry.prefetch.v1 ready for ingestion to prod-telemetry (build 2026-03-17-2).

mira: Great. For the token-saved formula, let's be explicit in dashboard notes: token_saved = sum(original_tokens - served_from_cache_tokens) per request, and for mixed hits we have two values: served_from_cache_tokens_strict (only pure prefix) and served_from_cache_tokens_loose (counts mixed).

alex: I'll add both series and a toggle. Also planning a per-tenant table with percentile-based confidence: p50/p90 token-saved per-request.

sam: One more ask — add a lightweight profiler link from the tenant row that opens the last sampled trace for that tenant/model combination. That will speed debugging regresses.

acheng: I have sampling hooks already in perf-profiles — will expose a short URL token in the telemetry event: profile_sample_url.

mira: Critical: we need alerts when observed token-saved drops >30% week-over-week for high-spend tenants, and a fast rollback playbook if a model rollout regresses warmup behavior.

alex: I'll add an alert rule (prod-telemetry) with owner @sam and runbook link.

sam: I'll draft the runbook: look at kernel_path trending, batching heuristics change, and recent model variant rollouts. Also include quick queries: a) tenants with most drop, b) top routes with changed key entropy.

acheng: Note: key entropy calculation is expensive at full-cardinality. Suggest we compute approximate entropy via sketching and surface only top-50 offending routes per tenant daily.

mira: Sounds reasonable. Timeline?

alex: Plan: land metric export & mixed_hit flag this week, wire dashboard next week, enable alerts Tue after QA.

sam: I'll take alert owner and runbook. Will jump in on dashboard review Wed.

acheng: I'll push kernel_path and profile_sample_url in the v1 telemetry export tonight.

ops-bot: deploy-bot: metric export v1 deployed to prod-telemetry at 1724300300.

alex: Thanks all — will post the dashboard link in #eng-runtime when ready. :rocket:
